# Edge Simulator — Local

Run the edge device simulator on your laptop.

## Setup (one time)

```bash
cd edge_simulator/local
pip install -r requirements.txt

# copy certs generated by terraform
mkdir -p certs
cp -r ../../certs/* ./certs/

# configure — copy the template and fill in your values
cp .env.example .env
```

`.env` holds the account-specific config that shouldn't be hardcoded in source:

```bash
# from: terraform output iot_endpoint  (infrastructure/)
IOT_ENDPOINT=xxxxxxxxxxxxxx-ats.iot.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

# must match infrastructure/terraform.tfvars: hmac_secret
HMAC_SECRET=your-hmac-secret
```

`.env` is gitignored — it never gets committed. Cert/key paths and topic already have
working defaults (see `.env.example` to override them).

## Run

**Which device to publish as is a per-run CLI choice, not something set in `.env`** — pass
`--client-id` to pick which of the three provisioned devices (`edge-device-001/002/003`)
you're simulating; it also selects which cert/key pair gets used:

```bash
python publish_to_iot.py --client-id edge-device-001 --count 10 --mode happy
python publish_to_iot.py --client-id edge-device-002 --count 10 --mode noisy
python publish_to_iot.py --client-id edge-device-003 --count 10 --mode network --loss 0.10
```

Omitting `--client-id` defaults to `edge-device-001`.

```bash
# normal data
python publish_to_iot.py --count 10 --mode happy

# with faults
python publish_to_iot.py --count 10 --fault-rate 0.2 --mode noisy

# inject specific fault
python publish_to_iot.py --count 5 --inject voltage_sag
python publish_to_iot.py --count 5 --inject overcurrent
python publish_to_iot.py --count 5 --inject frequency_drop

# attack scenarios
python publish_to_iot.py --count 10 --replay
python publish_to_iot.py --count 10 --mode attack
python publish_to_iot.py --count 20 --mode chaos --fault-rate 0.2
```

## Certs folder structure

```
certs/
├── root-CA.crt
├── edge-device-001/
│   ├── cert.pem
│   └── private.key
├── edge-device-002/
│   ├── cert.pem
│   └── private.key
└── edge-device-003/
    ├── cert.pem
    └── private.key
```
